description: Draft dose notes prepared from a user-supplied extract of BNF for Children 2023. Every note is marked unverified and must be checked against the complete current source before use. Version 3: adds items 81–120 (antimicrobials, cardiovascular drugs, PPIs, rufinamide); 'CHECK' notes mark entries that appear to differ from BNFc or mix indications. Re-importing adds only regimens you do not already have.
